REF Reference · Western and China build-outs

Timeline

From ChatGPT's launch to the lab IPO filings, and from East Data, West Compute to CXMT's listing: every dated event in the twenty layer dossiers of both tracks, merged into one sequence so you can see how chips, power, money and models moved together, and how each side answered the other.

Turning points
29

The Western build-out in five acts

  1. The shock (Nov 2022 – 2023). ChatGPT creates demand no one planned for; NVIDIA's May 2023 guidance starts the H100 scramble.
  2. The arms race (2024). Clouds and labs race for GPUs and power; Blackwell arrives and Sequoia asks who will pay.
  3. Mega-projects and circular deals (2025). Stargate, the DeepSeek scare, then suppliers funding their customers: NVIDIA, AMD and Broadcom with OpenAI.
  4. Agents, memory and balance sheets (H1 2026). Coding agents drive revenue, memory prices spike, and hyperscalers borrow.
  5. Public markets (mid-2026). SpaceX lists, Anthropic and OpenAI file for IPOs, and Oracle's credit is cut.

China's build-out in five acts

  1. The shock and the hundred-model war (Oct 2022 – 2023). US controls cut off the A100/H100; Baidu's ERNIE Bot starts a rush of model launches; platforms buy every Nvidia chip they are allowed.
  2. The price war and the glut (2024). DeepSeek-V2 and Doubao make tokens almost free; Big Fund III gets RMB 344bn; the US bans HBM exports.
  3. The DeepSeek moment and the domestic pivot (2025). R1 shakes Nvidia; Alibaba pledges RMB 380bn; Beijing itself blocks Nvidia and bans foreign chips from state-funded data centers.
  4. The capex doubling and the IPO wave (H1 2026). GPU makers and model labs list in Shanghai and Hong Kong; customs block the H200; DeepSeek V4 ships on Ascend.
  5. Stretched balance sheets (Jul – Sep 2026). CXMT lists; Tencent and Alibaba go free-cash-flow negative; Alibaba sells HK$80bn of shares and ByteDance borrows US$29.6bn.

The turning points

The 29 events that changed the direction of the build-out in the West, in China or in both. Each links to its place in the full timeline, where it is highlighted.

  • Feb 2022 · ChinaChina launches East Data, West Compute (东数西算): 8 hub nodes and 10 data-center clusters
  • 30 Nov 2022 · WestChatGPT launches
  • May 2023 · WestNVIDIA's guidance shock: FY24 Q2 guided to $11bn vs ~$7bn expected
  • May 2024 · ChinaChina's token price war: DeepSeek-V2 sets it off, Doubao prices at RMB 0.8 per million tokens and Alibaba cuts Qwen-Long 97%
  • 20 Jun 2024 · WestSequoia asks "AI's $600B question"
  • 2 Dec 2024 · ChinaUS bans HBM exports to China and lists 140 entities (incl. SiCarrier, Piotech, Empyrean)
  • Dec 2024 · WestOpenAI's o1 reasoning model and ChatGPT Pro ($200)
  • 21 Jan 2025 · WestStargate announced: $500B, 10 GW (OpenAI, SoftBank, Oracle, MGX)
  • 27 Jan 2025 · West + ChinaDeepSeek R1 "efficiency shock": NVIDIA falls 17% (−$600B) in a day
  • 22 Sep 2025 · WestNVIDIA–OpenAI letter of intent: 10 GW and up to $100B of investment
  • 6 Oct 2025 · WestAMD–OpenAI: 6 GW of GPUs plus a warrant for up to 160M AMD shares
  • Oct 2025 · WestMemory prices start to spike: conventional DRAM contracts +45–50% q/q
  • 29 Oct 2025 · WestNVIDIA becomes the first company worth $5 trillion
  • 5 Nov 2025 · ChinaBeijing bans foreign AI chips from state-funded data centers; projects less than 30% complete must remove them
  • Dec 2025 · WestPJM's 2027/28 capacity auction clears at the $333.44 cap with its first-ever shortfall (6.6 GW)
  • 8 Jan 2026 · ChinaZhipu (8 Jan) and MiniMax (9 Jan) list in Hong Kong
  • 12 Jan 2026 · WestClaude Cowork launches; the SaaS sell-off begins
  • 14 Jan 2026 · ChinaBIS sets case-by-case H200 licensing (13 Jan); Chinese customs declare the H200 "not permitted" (14 Jan), stranding ~US$54bn of orders
  • Jan 2026 · WestDRAM contract prices jump ~93–98% in a quarter, a record
  • 2 Feb 2026 · WestSpaceX acquires xAI in an all-stock deal ($250B for xAI, $1T for SpaceX)
  • 31 Mar 2026 · WestOpenAI closes $122B at $852B (Amazon $50B, NVIDIA $30B, SoftBank $30B)
  • Apr 2026 · WestAnthropic's run-rate passes $30B, overtaking OpenAI
  • 24 Apr 2026 · ChinaDeepSeek V4 preview ships, tied to Huawei Ascend (V4-Pro: 1.6T parameters, 49B active)
  • 26 May 2026 · WestMicron's market value passes $1 trillion
  • 1 Jun 2026 · WestAnthropic (1 Jun) and OpenAI (8 Jun) file confidentially for IPOs
  • 12 Jun 2026 · WestSpaceX IPO raises ~$75B at ~$1.77T, the largest ever
  • 9 Jul 2026 · WestS&P cuts Oracle to BBB-, one notch above junk
  • 27 Jul 2026 · ChinaCXMT lists on STAR: RMB 57.9bn raised, +466% on day one (~RMB 3.28tn market value)
  • 17 Aug 2026 · WestNVIDIA guarantees up to $105bn of OpenAI's Ohio leases (8 GW, with SoftBank)
